name: What types of subfloor issues are common in older homes and how are they addressed?

mainEntity.name: What types of subfloor issues are common in older homes and how are they addressed?

acceptedAnswer.text: Older homes frequently have subfloor issues such as unevenness, squeaks, rot, or damage from water or pests. Unevenness often requires leveling compounds or adding shims. Squeaks typically indicate loose boards that need re-securing with screws. Rot or significant damage necessitates removal and replacement of affected sections. Identifying and addressing these issues is crucial, as a compromised subfloor will negatively impact the stability, longevity, and appearance of any new flooring installation. Proper subfloor preparation is foundational to a successful project.
acceptedAnswer.description: Common issues include unevenness, squeaks, rot, or damage, addressed by leveling, re-securing, or replacing sections. Proper subfloor preparation is critical for new flooring stability.
